title: The Moral question of the trial
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：moral　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 moral 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the nurse wrote of ① a moral question of the trial in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so moral that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the moral ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the moral question of the trial that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too moral to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the moral ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a moral duty of the doctor, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as moral as the duty of the doctor they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was moral or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something moral, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite moral; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the moral ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, year after year, she wrote of another moral question of the trial in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less moral than anybody had expected. ⑩ The moral duty of the doctor that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the moral ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 道德（前置定语 a moral question of the trial：1973 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件道德的问题）
B. adj. 道德／道义上（两处加强说法：so moral that … 与 no less moral than …）
C. adj. 道德／道义上（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 道德（表语 too moral to do：母亲觉得它太道德，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 道义上（前置定语 a moral duty of the doctor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩道义上的责任）
F. adj. 道义上（同级比较 as moral as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩大夫道义上的责任相比）
G. adj. 道义上（后置定语 something moral：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 道义上（受程度副词修饰 quite moral：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a moral question of the trial
the moral question of the trial that
a moral duty of the doctor
The moral duty of the doctor that

answers.why: moral 意为“道德”，1973 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件道德的问题”，此处作前置定语 a moral question of the trial。
moral 意为“道德”，此处用 so moral that 结构，说它道德到病房里没人敢靠近。
moral 意为“道德”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的道德试验引发的道德问题，等于最高级的说法。
moral 意为“道德”，母亲认为这件东西“太道德了，谁也用不上”，too moral to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
moral 意为“道义上”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩道义上的责任”，此处作前置定语 a moral duty of the doctor。
moral 意为“道义上”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩大夫道义上的责任一样道义上”，同级比较用 as moral as。
moral 意为“道义上”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“道义上的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something moral。
moral 意为“道义上”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当道义上”，quite 修饰原级 moral。
moral 意为“道义上”，no less moral than 表示“其道义上不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之道义上不亚于任何人的预料。
moral 意为“道义上”，母亲 1985 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的道义上责任”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件道德的问题。（a moral question of the trial）
它道德到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so moral that …）
母亲觉得它太道德，谁也用不上。（too moral to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩道义上的责任。（a moral duty of the doctor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩大夫道义上的责任一样道义上。（as moral as …）
到了 1980 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件道义上的东西。（something moral）
answers: In 1973 the nurse wrote of a moral question of the trial in the report.
It was so moral that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too moral to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a moral duty of the doctor.
He said nobody would call it as moral as the duty of the doctor they had once had.
By 1980 the report asked for nothing but something moral.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 moral 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the nurse wrote of a moral question of the trial in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the moral question of the trial that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too moral to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a moral duty of the doctor, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite moral, and everybody laughed.
The moral ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
